scope: Verifier corrections, not lesson implementation defects

issues.observation: First enhanced geometry run included teaching-panel itself as a descendant subject to its own inner padding; returned padding=[teaching-panel].
issues.resolution: Exclude the panel node from its descendant inner-padding containment set. Keep every actual descendant check.

issues.observation: Playwright route handler supplied Request as the optional second parameter intended to capture fixture data. 24 default states already passed; first custom fixture could not be serialized.
issues.resolution: Use a single-argument route closure for the synchronous fixture context. No lesson-source change.

issues.observation: Immediate programmatic parent reload after a child Select change raced the postMessage URL synchronization.
issues.resolution: Wait for the parent URL to reflect the selected kernel, then test reload preservation. This still requires eventual synchronization and matches the actual asynchronous iframe contract.

issues.observation: The exact content.html route glob did not match the actual iframe URL containing version/kernel query parameters, so the intended content failure was not injected.
issues.resolution: Match a wildcard suffix for faulted lesson resources; use the same complete pattern when removing the route for retry.

issues.observation: The initial bare content.html document can be superseded before its model/app requests finish, producing ERR_ABORTED for obsolete requests although the final versioned document is fully successful.
issues.resolution: Preserve raw URL/referrer/failure/resource-type for exact same-origin ERR_ABORTED requests of the initial bare document or assets initiated by that bare document. Versioned-document asset failures and other cancellations still fail validation.
issues.follow_up_runtime_fix: The Builder removed duplicate bare-document initialization. The final verifier requires zero request cancellations as well as zero current-resource failures.
